purpose: Test if simple script tags are intercepted or escaped correctly by the interface/validation layer.
expectedResult: Should be rejected by validation if strict markup is disallowed, or safely encoded/escaped on output rendering.

purpose: Test if arbitrary HTML tags can be injected into fields that might render as HTML.
expectedResult: Should be sanitized or plaintext encoded. Rich text editor fields must strip unapproved tags.

purpose: Test if event handlers inside attributes (e.g. onload, onerror) are parsed and executed.
expectedResult: Must be stripped during rich text sanitization or rejected by the input validation pattern.

purpose: Test javascript pseudo-protocol links inside href attributes.
expectedResult: javascript: URIs must be disallowed, filtered, or redacted during rendering/validation.
